visual.general_description: Two stacked grayscale head MRI slices, sagittal (A) and coronal (B), each with printed sequence text, showing a rounded structure in the sellar region.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a sagittal slice labelled "Sag T1 FSE  FINO +C" and panel B is a coronal slice labelled "COR T1 FSE  FINO +C", each with orange orientation-style letters. In panel A a rounded structure of intermediate-to-bright signal lies in the sellar region above a dark air-filled space; in panel B a midline structure of intermediate signal sits in the sellar region and extends upward, above a larger rounded grey area.

panels.general_description: Grayscale sagittal head MRI slice with printed sequence text at the top and a rounded soft-tissue structure in the sellar and suprasellar region.
panels.detailed_description: Midline sagittal slice of the head in grayscale. Printed white text at the top reads "Sag T1 FSE  FINO +C" with orange letters "HLP" beneath it, and a panel letter A is at the upper left. A well-defined rounded structure of intermediate-to-bright signal sits in the region of the sella turcica with a dark air-filled space below it. Brain structures and part of the nasal and facial region are visible. Black bands are at the left and right edges.
